outcome.answer: You can make recommender systems better for “user goals” by explicitly modeling the reasons and intents behind user choices, rather than only inferring preferences from implicit interactions. For example, LLM-based recommendation can prioritize “explicit context feedback” such as reviews and comments to capture the semantic reasons behind decisions and improve preference alignment and explainability [1]. You can also extract and use high-level intents in sequential recommendation by anchoring reasoning to intents, improving robustness and moving from surface item-to-item memorization toward intrinsic behavior patterns [4].
